string.comment: Pronunciation: Neeyamba-Tehogo-Ongo-Beek… LAKE OF FIRE... Kombay-Peeyapod-Fein… THE SECOND DEATH... Koog-Hay-Digee... Ooaah-Kombay-Yeebeek. Ooaah-Kombay-Yeebeek! OOAAH-KOMBAY-YEEBEEK!
string.direction: Stage-whisper (all caps never means shouting, however the final Corrupted phrase should be said with much intensity)
string.context: Translation: "God waits for you… LAKE OF FIRE… Die full of regret… THE SECOND DEATH… Old and new… Death to you. Death to you! DEATH TO YOU!" This triggers at the start of the Cursed Reliquary IGC, so get two versions: spoken at a fare pace, and then spoken at a slower pace. We switch to English because the player is starting to understand Corruption language.
string.speaker: Corruption Whisper
string.name: CorruptionWhisper

resources.string: Namba t'ehoxo ngo bih... LAKE OF FIRE... Kombe pi'a pad fin... THE SECOND DEATH… Kux he degi…

string.comment: Pronunciation: Teek-Dek… YOU SEEK… Mahbah-yeeb… ASCENSION…
string.context: Translation: "Man flesh… YOU SEEK… Human… ASCENSION…" Corruption language is becoming more understandable to the player.
string.speaker: Corruption Whisper
string.name: CorruptionWhisper

resources.string: Tih deh… YOU SEEK… Mabayib… ASCENSION…

string.comment: Pronunciation: WE SEEK MORTALITY… Dempapog-Kaiya… FIND THE KEY TO ASCENSION…
string.context: Translation: "WE SEEK MORTALITY… Fresh meat… FIND THE KEY TO ASCENSION…" Corruption language continues to become understandable to the player.
string.speaker: Corruption Whisper
string.name: CorruptionWhisper

resources.string: WE SEEK MORTALITY… Dempapox kaya… FIND THE KEY TO ASCENSION…

string.context: The 'ashen token' is a reagent that the Corrupted Prisoner drops when destroyed by the player. She has now reentered the resurrection cycle and is spawning elsewhere in Nighthaven to get up to some new mischief.
string.speaker: Corruption Whisper
string.name: CorruptionWhisper

resources.string: SHE RETURNS TO HER VESSEL AND LEAVES YOU AN ASHEN TOKEN OF HER JOY. WE WILL BE A PART OF YOU TOO. YOUR BOON IS WAITING.

string.context: In the final Inquisition POI, gross Corruption nodules are growing like weeds. The players previous actions have unwittingly caused Corruption to grow in Nighthaven.
string.speaker: Corruption Whisper
string.name: CorruptionWhisper

resources.string: THE HEART OF OURSELVES GROWS EXPONENTIALLY. YOU ALLOW OUR BLEEDING FLOOD TO EXPAND OUTWARDS. YES.

string.context: Triggers when the player picks up the final Seraphic Body Part (the heart of the Heartless Seraph). This emphasizes that Corruption has fully moved on from seeing the Seraphim as valuable, and instead seeks to use the player now and in the future.
string.speaker: Corruption Whisper
string.name: CorruptionWhisper

resources.string: THIS MEAT IS AN EMPTY VESSEL. BUT OUR HEART WILL BEAT WITH YOU. A PULSE THROUGH ONE ETERNITY TO THE NEXT.

string.context: Triggers when the player begins the Corruption Ritual at the Inquisition Monastery. 'Journey backwards' again refers to Corruption traveling backwards in time. The final phrase in this whisper (and the next three) is meant to be computer terminology, but should be spoken naturally so as to sound like a command to the player rather than a Tron-like "end of line" commentary.
string.speaker: Corruption Whisper
string.name: CorruptionWhisper

resources.string: WILL YOU REPEAT THE PAST OF THE FALLEN SERAPHIM? WE REPEAT YOUR PAST AS WE JOURNEY BACKWARDS.

string.context: Triggers when the player summons the Sky Horror in the sky, a looming mass of Corruption.
string.speaker: Corruption Whisper
string.name: CorruptionWhisper

resources.string: YES. OPEN THE GATE. LET US RETURN BEFORE WE GO TOO FAR. YES. OPEN THE GATE.

string.context: Triggers when the player lights the Seraphic Torches, further inviting Corruption to enter Nighthaven in full power.
string.speaker: Corruption Whisper
string.name: CorruptionWhisper

resources.string: THE CRACK IN THE DOOR WIDENS. WE SEE YOU. WE ARE WITH YOU. WE ARE KNOCKING.

string.context: Triggers when the player reaches the Corrupted Tree. Corruption is on the verge to entering Nighthaven and taking control of the entire zone.
string.speaker: Corruption Whisper
string.name: CorruptionWhisper

resources.string: TAKE US OVER THE THRESHOLD. WE EMBRACE YOU. YES. WE NEVER LEFT. OUR LOVE IS AGELESS.
Uwakombe yi bih. Uwakombe yi bih! UWAKOMBE YI BIH!
Use Azoth Staff on the Corrupted Tree to Subvert the Ritual
The Corrupted Tree
Sacrifice the Inquisitors to Bind the All-Giving Eye
Spill the Essence of the Unworthy Masses upon the Roots of Glory
Baptize the Graves of Unknowing with the Lament of Aeons
Strange Object
It feels like it does not have substance and should not belong in any rational world.
Inscrutable Map
Either a sketch of underground passageways or a mess of pointless doodles.
Enter the Mausoleum
Exit the Mausoleum

string.direction: In warning, slightly detached since it's a recording
string.context: This is Ser Crusader's voice, 'recorded' into the statue as a warning trigger (so not sentient). The voice speaks as he normally will as a person, and we'll post-process it to sound like a statue.
string.speaker: Angel Statue
string.name: AngelStatue

resources.string: Be you of ill intent, pass on by these Gates of Pandemonium. Be you of good heart, enter the horrors that lie herein. May all beware!
[The air around the Angel Statue seems to stir, as if in recognition.]
[The Angel Statue regards you impassively.]
<Leave an offering to the Crusader>
[The silence deepens, as if it is slowly turning to stone. There is a final whisper of unseen movement as the gate settles into place. Then that too is gone forever, and you are alone.]
I think this is the complete dialogue.

string.context: Tries and fails to introduce himself. He deteriorates as the quest line goes on, and this is the first evidence that he has forgotten things once important.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Your pardon, but the long passage of time has winnowed from me my name. All I remember is that I was... I am... a Lightshield Crusader. The very last of my Order.

string.context: Incomplete line when he is at his Catacomb position before the final quest steps.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: I shall await your inevitable victory, though my form is failing me with such rapidity I can barely sense you standing before me.

string.context: Player has succesfully purged the Reliquary, and theirselves, of Corruption. At the end, Ser Crusader is quoting the Bible verse that says "The hand cannot say to the eye: I have no need of thee."
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Ahh... you have done the impossible task and with much grace, in truth. All is darkness in my sight. I cannot see a single finger on this hand of mine. "I have no need of thee"? Ha!

string.context: Even though he seeing nothing at all, the one thing still visible in the Azoth blue that the player is emanating (likely their soul).
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: But you! You are burnished in such a blinding azure!
"And you?"

string.direction: Coming back to himself, becoming more and more detached
string.context: The vision of the player's Azoth blue is disappearing, as if he is being pulled away. And yet it never fully disappears from his sight, or loses any intensity.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: And I? I am receding, my friend. I am drawn away from you at a tremendous speed. We are distanced as if by centuries. You are star-like. So small, and yet so fiercely bright and unwavering.

string.context: Reflecting on this sight he is beholding.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: That I have lived through such times to see such a sight. Praise be...
"Rest in peace, my friend."

string.direction: No longer aware of the player, in complete awe, whispered to himself
string.context: Just before he completely disappears, he sees something overwhelming and indescribable.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: What... wonder...
It is done.

string.context: He describes the Monastery where the player will be summoning and imprisoning each Seraph. It's a grand location, but has fallen into visual decrepitude.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: One day, long ago, this was the site of so many good intentions! Now it is a hollow monument to death, and a grim reminder of our moral failure.

string.direction: Shaken out of his reverie, back to matter-of-fact
string.context: With his ghostly form, it is impossible for him to physically manipulate any objects. Player must do the work alone.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Very good. My incorporeal state is increasingly useless, so I must rely on your noble works and diligent hands.
"Who was the Blind Seraph?"

string.context: Inferring that Alecksi was the one enemy they could not overcome. Also the "he" that suggested the use of Corruption was the Blind Seraph, the previously mentioned master tactician.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Our master tactician, who routed every enemy we encountered on the field of battle, except one. The Warrior King was unyielding. And so he suggested we seek Corruption's power...
"A motion borne of desperation."

string.context: The Blind Seraph, once falling to the influence of Corruption, sought ways to weaken and destroy the Lightshield Crusade and turn it into the Inquisition.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Then his sight turned inwards, so cruelly, found our weakpoints and... culled them, like a barbaric surgeon, until we were a shadow of our glory.
"He was a skilled manipulator."

string.context: Shifting from exposition to getting the player ready to summon the Blind Seraph
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: But that is an old story now. What you do this day is your story. And our struggle is only now begun.
"First, I must deal with the Seraph."

string.context: Instructive for the repeated conceit in this quest line: interact with brazier to burn the previously gathered Body Part and Reagent to begin the summoning and begin the Soul Trial
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Just so. Find the statue dedicated to the Sightless One. Burn his eyes, along with the silk. This will force his pestilential spirit hither, and imprison him. Then you must go and slay him.
I have gathered everything.

string.context: While he was sure that their plan of summoning and slaying would work previously, now he has concrete proof that if one Seraph can be destroyed this way, so can all the others.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: There can be no doubt now, as we have proven the method. Now must you hunt down the remaining vestiges of the Seraphim's humanity and cast them all into cleansing fire.

string.context: His complicated emotional experience is the new ordeal, the mixture of memories that remain and his mixed feelings towards the need to destroy his former comrades.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Your pardon, if it please you. This is not easy. It has... become another ordeal, perhaps even greater than the first.

string.direction: Apologetic, more bemused and embarassed than upset
string.context: Player has completed the third Soul Trial. Now Ser Crusader's form is deteriorating even more.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: I apologize for my lacking usefulness. It seems that the less there are of the Seraphim, the less there is of me. Could this be my final death, I wonder?

string.context: Player has completed the Final Soul Trial
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Oh my friend, I could not have hoped for a more thorough deliverance! To know that my failures exist only within my memories, and no longer in Aeternum... it is a weight I thought would never be lifted!
[You feel an energy reaching out to you, probing the edges of your Heartgem as if for entry.]
[You feel an energy reaching out to you, probing the edges of your Heartgem as if for entry.]
[A deeper silence descends in your presence. It feels like it is watching you. Waiting for you.]
Xai k'oba ngo mah… Xai k'oba ngo mah… Xai k'oba ngo mah…
Xai k'oba ngo mah… Xai k'oba ngo mah… Xai k'oba ngo mah…

string.context: Corruption language is fully understandable to the player from this point forward. While this is Corruption talking to the player as in previous whispers, it is puppeteering the words through the Corrupted Prisoner lady and only using her voice.
string.speaker: Voice of Corruption
string.name: VoiceOfCorruption

resources.string: YOU DO NOT KNOW THE FOLLY OF MANKIND THE DESCENT INTO MADDENING WONDER.

string.context: Corruption admits that past attempts to Corrupt people haven't worked to its specifications yet, but it is ready to continue trying more people (like the player).
string.speaker: Voice of Corruption
string.name: VoiceOfCorruption

resources.string: THE GRAVES ARE EMPTY AND WE REMAIN, WAITING FOR MORE VESSELS TO FILL TO BURSTING.
"Tell me of the Seraph!"

string.context: Corruption describes its view of the Breathless Seraph (but ultimately all the Seraphim).
string.speaker: Voice of Corruption
string.name: VoiceOfCorruption

resources.string: A HOLLOW PUPPET VOIDED OF INTENT A FOUL CREATED FAILURE OF LOGIC CASTOFF DETRITUS. THEY COULD NOT BECOME US. THEIR GLORY WAS NOT OURS.

string.context: Achieving "wonder" is the Corruption's ultimate goal, but whatever that actually means it isn't good for humanity, the world, or reality itself.
string.speaker: Voice of Corruption
string.name: VoiceOfCorruption

resources.string: YOU WILL KNOW OUR WONDER.
"I reject Corruption."

string.direction: Full confidence, has already experienced this future
string.context: Corruption is displaced from time, and is likely experiencing the human world backwards from future to past. From its perspective, the player has already completed this predictive list of things that they will do in the final quest.
string.speaker: Voice of Corruption
string.name: VoiceOfCorruption

resources.string: YOU ARE ALREADY WALKING THEIR PATH. YOUR FOOTSTEPS ON THE PILGRIMAGE OF PAIN. YOU TOUCH THE TREE. YOU RAISE A STAFF. YOU PLAY YOUR PART.

string.context: Corruption believes it is also puppeteering the player in their actions. So rather than manipulation, it is trying to prove that it is an inevitable future.
string.speaker: Voice of Corruption
string.name: VoiceOfCorruption

resources.string: WE HAVE IN KNOWING PREPARED YOUR WAY: THE BIRTH PANGS OF THE LONG-AWAITED SLOUGHING. WE GRANT YOU A BOON TO PROVE OUR INEVITABILITY.

string.direction: Deal-making, quid pro quo, joyful in the final sentence
string.context: First part refers to the Seraphic Body Part the player has come here to collect. In the final sentence, some of the Corrupted Prisoner's consciousness is returning: she feels such joy to have the ability to perform tasks for Corruption again.
string.speaker: Voice of Corruption
string.name: VoiceOfCorruption

resources.string: ABOVE WE PRESERVE RASPING BREATHS UNSCREAMED CENTURIES. THIS BOON IS YOURS WHEN YOU RELEASE THIS CREATURE FROM BONDAGE. SHE HAS TASKS TO PERFORM YET.
Speak to me.
Xai k'oba ngo mah… Xai k'oba ngo mah… Xai k'oba ngo mah…
Be careful in the... catacombs. They are full of... nitre. Heh. Heh heh heh...
Ah. Another 'petitioner'. Lovely.
Stop starrrring.
[The Reliquary is at peace and no longer tainted by Corruption.]
Don't worry, you can sleep late, no need to be up with the dawn here, even if I am!
"I must enter."

string.direction: In warning, slightly detached since it's a recording
string.context: This is Ser Crusader's voice, 'recorded' into the statue as a warning trigger (so not sentient). The voice speaks as he normally will as a person, and we'll post-process it to sound like a statue.
string.speaker: Angel Statue
string.name: AngelStatue

resources.string: Then seek salvation alone, lest all freedom be taken from you as it was from me.
[The Angel Statue is as silent and inevitable as the grave.]
Complete the Quest

string.context: After becoming tainted by the Corrupted Reliquary and releasing the Corrupt Seraphim from "sleep", the player discovers Ser Crusader standing nearby. He speaks about the Seraphim, who sacrificed him centuries ago.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Now have you seen the fiends that bound me to these accursed halls. Those wretched betrayers that sacrificed my life to ascend into powers foul and unnatural!
"Did I free them?"

string.context: The location where they are is broken and no longer fully sealed. He was fighting a losing battle keep the Seraphim there.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: You did not. Be assuaged of these fears. I have kept them in stasis for years uncounted, but my own power was waning... as you can see from that sundered wall. One day, they would have escaped.

string.context: While he was keeping the Seraphim stuck in place, he had no power to destroy any of them. The power of a Soulwarden, however, could do that.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: And you are a Soulwarden! You are the hope for which I prayed! Now is there a chance to destroy the Seraphim utterly and not simply entomb them with myself.
"A final end to your suffering…"

string.context: Admits this is a huge undertaking to destroy them, but sets himself up as the player's ally.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Indeed. But I fear this struggle will pit you against most fearsome odds. Take heart! For I shall be your steadfast ally in this our shared purpose.
"You all fought the Inquisition."

string.context: The Inquisition was once the Lightshield Crusade, until Corruption perverted it completely.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: No, indeed, we did not. We became the Inquisition! That is a sordid tale, and the burden falls heavy upon my shoulders to be the sole remaining voice to tell it.
"Who is it you've kept with you?"

string.context: Describes the four Seraphim that disappeared from the chamber when the player approached the Cursed Reliquary.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Those four interred with the Reliquary were the Seraphim. Our former illustrious leaders, brought as low as to the abyssal depths by their dalliance with Corruption. We must destroy them!
"But I must save you first."

string.context: Ser Crusader is a transparent, ghostly blue apparition in-game. While he has died, he is unable to return to the resurrection cycle like normal players.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: No… no. It is too late for that. I am trapped, as your eyes well see, between death and life. The promise of resurrection is denied to me, so this may very well be my eternal fate.

string.context: Reorienting player to overall goal of destroying the freed Seraphim, and setting up the basic quest conceit: gather a Seraphic Body Part and Reagent.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: But if you can defeat all four Seraphim, that would be comfort enough. Each sacrificed an aspect of self, and by gathering that and the correct reagent we can imprison and subdue them.
"I will find them at once."

string.context: Giving directions to the two first POIs the player must visit.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: The Blind Seraph sacrificed his eye at Ashfall Watch, as I watched helplessly from far below. A fitting reagent would be from Silkfoot Crag, something so gossamer that it is nearly invisible.
"I'll gather what we need."

string.context: Giving directions to the repeat POI of the quest lines, where the player always fights the Seraphim Soul Trials.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: When your preparations are complete, meet me at Monastery Isle to the south. There will we confer upon the summoning.

string.context: While the player's existence offers hope of ending the Seraphim's threat, he aware of how threatening Corruption is in all its forms.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Though I cannot say how long it has truly been since the sacrifice, Corruption will have preserved that loathsome eyeball. You can be assured of that grievous fact...
Complete the Quest

string.context: Player has completed the first Soul Trial and returned to him outside
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: You are victorious! These are wondrous tidings. I did worry for your life, but chose to have faith - and now my faith is thus rewarded.
"I am resolved to continue."

string.context: Describing the backstory of the Second Seraph, the Mute Seraph
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Very good. I recall that the commander of our vanguard was once stationed at Biteback Bivouac. From there did he spew his most hateful rhetoric, and many listened.
"A pitiful effort to rally support."

string.context: Before the Crusade became the Inquisition (but was actively transitioning into it), he kept trying and failing to prevent that decline
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: I thought that if I stayed by his side I might temper his most ardent zealotry. Alas, all I profited was an intimate view of the degeneration of our Order and hastened my own undoing.
"This too will require a reagent?"

string.context: Focusing the player on the next objectives
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Indeed, it will. Collecting the blood of ghouls will be your task. A fitting liquid to gather from a monster as rabid as the Second Seraph himself.
"I'll find that at Amurg Cimitir."

string.context: This is the only Seraph that Ser Crusader speaks of with this kind of regret. It is likely he and the Mute Seraph were close once.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: How fervently I believed I could sway him! It feels so insidious to be planning his demise now. Even after being destroyed myself, I cannot help wishing he could, instead, be saved.

string.context: Ready to continue with the player, but conflicted emotionally by his history with the villainous Seraphim
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: I look forward to our gains in this dreadful undertaking. And yet my heart weeps for my brethren who have chosen this most wicked path.
Complete the Quest

string.context: Player has completed the second Soul Trial successfully. This is a good thing, but Ser Crusader is dealing with a lot of emotional baggage. The initial excitement is gone.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: So, it is done. I fear the thrill of the defeat of the First Seraph possessed my heart. But now, all I can feel is the grief of what has been. And what has been lost.
"But their torment must end, too."

string.context: A slightly internalized line, as he considers his lack of a physical body while yet retaining the ability to experience emotion.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: How strange that I should feel such pain in my chest, yet my heart has not beaten for centuries. Perhaps I should be grateful for this pang that proves my conscience.
"Are you unwell?"

string.context: Inferring that the lives of the Seraphim are what is binding him in his state between the resurrection cycle. As the power of each is destroyed, parts of him are likewise destroyed (power and memory).
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: I am, my friend. I can barely perceive you. With each victory, a little piece of myself dissolves away into... nothingness? I know naught, but I feel diminished.
"How do you know?"

string.context: Describing what he can, at this very moment, actually see. To him, it is just blackness now with some occassional features. The antechamber is the Monastery room where he and the player are now located physically.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: I can see... blackness, all around. A great and awesome void. And at times I do, I think, spy the edges of this grand antechamber. Other times I can see you... dimming, yet a brilliant azure flame.
"I have been there before."

string.context: He is now describing what the player experienced when they died in the FTUE, where Isabella first appeared from the portal. That is actually where Ser Crusader is right now, but as time has gone on he no longer sees those defining features.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Yes, the shoreline with an uncertain tide. Stars above that are not, I believe, entirely our own. I stopped seeing these things... I could not say when. If I could let go... would I resurrect anymore, or...?
"We must free you from this."

string.context: His forgetting info about the Third Seraph is very likely happening because the player killed the first two. He just knew the info, but it eludes him now completely.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: While the last two Seraphim persist, that would be impossible. And now the tragedy in which we are bound deepens: I cannot remember anything of our Order's historian, the Third Seraph.
"Perhaps at Tularest's library?"

string.context: He does not remember if this is true or not, but encourages the player as it sounds like a logical plan worth investigating.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Ah! Perhaps! We once inhabited those hallowed halls in greener days, and some sign of our passing may yet linger. I cannot speak for certain, but I do implore you to seek and find what you will.

string.direction: Reflective, a touch of sorrow at the end
string.context: Losing his memories and power, he is feeling rather alone and has only what memories remain to hold on to. Sadly, none of those memories are very happy anymore.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: At our height, our Order was one of action. But even then, I recall there was much waiting. It was a time of reflection, and prayer. I fear there are no hymns in my heart here.
Complete the Quest

string.context: Player returns to Ser Crusader after investigating info on the Third Seraph and gathering ingredients to summon him.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: You managed to uncover the information needed on your own? And the materials too? Well done!
"Or your next resurrection."

string.context: He no longer considers resurrection a possibility, and probably gave up on that hope ages ago.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Am I not bereft of such a hope? In this labor of ours, I can scarcely fathom what may be in store for me. It may well be as you say.
"Do not give up."

string.context: Takes him a moment to come around to rekindling hope, but he accepts the player's perspective despite everything.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: I confess that I had chosen to do so. It felt easier to accept oblivion if I did not mentally languish against its embrace. But you speak properly. I must endure!
"Where should we focus next?"

string.context: Focusing the player on the final POI to visit, where all the action takes place this time
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Algarot Hall! Our pernicious leader tore out his fell heart atop its spires. There, seek you the destruction of the Final Seraph!
"Do you remember what happened?"

string.context: The power of this memory is likely why it has not disappeared like the others.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Even in my faltering memories, that image is burned into the back of my eyes! The gall! The blasphemous arrogance of accepting the poisoned fruits of Corruption's many temptations!
"It seems he gave into its power."

string.direction: The outrage ceases to be restrained
string.context: His passion here likely causes him, in his uncertain state, to reexperience this moment. He is very present in his denunciation, as if the Seraphim were there and still dragging him behind their carriage.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: I tell you: I defied him then, and I defied the Inquisition until my last breath! Dragging me from the Monastery to the Catacombs... oh, how I cursed them.
"You kept your soul intact."

string.context: As the final quest in the series, he orients the player to the needed ingredients
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: But I forget myself in my passions. If you can gather holy salts at that same place, we can end this horror. I leave the rest to you.

string.context: Psyching the player up for the coming difficulties
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Steel yourself! This will be a most fearsome fight indeed. And with his fellows so struck down, the fury of the Final Seraph will descend on you alone in full force.
Complete the Quest

string.context: All four Seraphim are dead. Ser Crusader's plan to defeat them worked and their reign of terror is ended.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Can it finally be over? My tormenters, my betrayers, gone forever? Merciful heavens, it is done. It is done! Praise be!
"Yet my curse remains, and grows."

string.context: Despite victory, the player is technically still tainted by Corruption since they touched the Cursed Reliquary in the first quest.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: You shall be absolved of this presently. Know that once the Inquisition was as holy as its ultimate aim, until our lack of self-doubt became our undoing.
"A path I will not take."

string.context: The final quest involves travelling from the Monastery POI to the Catacombs POI. Focuses the player on that journey.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: As the final sacrifice, I was bound to both the Monastery and the Catacombs. This means the energies of the ritual, while now dormant, can be manipulated still.
"I could recreate the ritual."

string.context: He is describing the same ritual that the Four Seraphim used to ascend into their Seraphic Corrupted forms.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Loathe though I am to agree, that is correct. If you follow in their footsteps, you can use a ritual to open the channels of Azoth wide - like bloodletting an old wound.
"If that is what I must do."

string.context: Ser Crusader is effectively telling the player to recreate the ritual sacrifice that destroyed himself centuries ago, but to omit the final step in order to subvert Corruption.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Take the pilgrimage north through the land of the dead, lighting the Seraphic Torches along your way. This will awaken Corruption, allowing you the opportunity to purge the Reliquary and yourself.

string.context: Reminder to the player on what to do when he is still at his Monastery position.
string.speaker: Lightshield Crusader
string.name: SerCrusader

resources.string: Go then. Walk the path of the past, in our long-forgotten footsteps, and learn from it what you may. I will meet you on the other side, and we will purge Corruption from the Reliquary.
Complete the Quest

<Leave an offering to the Crusader>
[The silence deepens, as if it is slowly turning to stone. There is a final whisper of unseen movement as the offering settles into place. Then that too is gone forever, and you are alone.]
